title: She Gave Up the Mafia Throne for Him
description: She walked away from the Mafia throne for the man she loved — and seven years later, he's forced to face what that cost her. A roughly 120-minute YouTube upload with over 2.6 million views since its August 2026 release.

audienceReactions.quote: That elderly housekeeper isn't paid enough.
audienceReactions.author: @AishaKassim-n6q

audienceReactions.quote: morale of the story: never erase yourself for someone else, be it husband, child or father. You should work a balance between you and the people you love, standing together, not as a door mat.
audienceReactions.author: @kmomenifa

audienceReactions.quote: DANG I love how merciless the female lead is and her bestie? I freaking love her
